# The weak verb

## Introduction

The letters
alif/hamzah
([أ]{.ar}),
;waw;,
and
;yaa;
are considered weak letters.
When any of these letters are part of the root of a verb,
then that verb is called a _weak verb_.
When weak verbs are conjugated for different ;faa3il;s,
then the weak letters can modify the appearance of the conjugated verb
in different ways.

Of the weak letters, hamzah is the strongest (in pronunciation, though it is weak in writing).
And it will usually (though not always) retain its pronunciation when a verb with hamzah in its root is conjugated.
So we will treat it separately at the end.

## The weak-middle-letter verb

### ;waw; as the weak-middle-letter

Consider the root
[قول]{.ar} with the meaning [to say]{.trans}.

When we form the ;madi; verb from roots with ;waw; as the middle root letter,
we usually assume a ;amark; on the middle root letter.

Therefore, we would expect the verb for the ;faa3il; [he]{.trans}
to be
[قَوَلَ]{.ar}
[qawala]{.trn}.
Instead, however,
the sequence [قَوَ]{.ar} [qawa]{.trn} is modified to [قَا]{.ar} [qA]{.trn},
and we will actually say:

(@) [قَالَ]{.ar}  
    [qAla]{.trn}  
    [He said]{.trans}

Similarly, when we conjugate for the ;faa3il;
[she]{.trans},
we would expect to say
[قَوَلَتْ]{.ar}
[qawalat]{.trn},
but we actually say:

(@) [قَالَتْ]{.ar}
    [qAlat]{.trn}  
    [She said]{.trans}

Continuing on, when we conjugate for the ;faa3il; [I]{.trans},
we would expect to say
[قَوَلْتُ]{.ar}
[qawaltu]{.trn}.
In this case, we don't convert
[قَوَ]{.ar} [qawa]{.trn} to [قَا]{.ar} [qA]{.trn}
because
then we would end up with
[قَالْتُ]{.ar}
[qAltu]{.trn}.
But a long vowel followed by a ;0mark; is disallowed phonologically
in Arabic
(except when pausing at the end of an utterance).
So we cannot say ;x;\ [قَالْتُ]{.ar} [qAltu]{.trn}.

Instead, we eliminiate the middle letter altogether,
and place a ;umark; on the [ق]{.ar} because it is the closest vowel to the original root letter ;waw;.
So we say:

(@) [قُلْتُ]{.ar}  
    [qultu]{.trn}  
    [I said]{.trans}  

Similarly we will say

(@) [قُلْتَ]{.ar}  
    [qulta]{.trn}  
    [You~sing.m.~ said]{.trans}  

(@) [قُلْتِ]{.ar}  
    [qulti]{.trn}  
    [You~sing.f.~ said]{.trans}  

Moving on to the duals,
for strong verbs we simply add an alif to
[ذَهَبَ]{.ar}
[he went]{.trans}
to get
[ذَهَبَا]{.ar}
[they~du.m.~ went]{.trans}.
And from
[ذَهَبَتْ]{.ar}
[she went]{.trans}
we get
[ذَهَبَتَا]{.ar}
[they~du.f.~ went]{.trans}.

We will do the same thing to
[قَالَ]{.ar}
and
[قَالَتْ]{.ar}
respectively.
So we get:

(@) [قَالَا]{.ar}  
    [qAlA]{.trn}  
    [They~du.m.~ said]{.trans}

(@) [قَالَتَا]{.ar}  
    [qAlatA]{.trn}  
    [They~du.f.~ said]{.trans}

For [you~du~ said]{.trans},
we use
[قُلْتُ]{.ar}
[I said]{.trans}
as our starting point and replace the ;faa3il; pronoun [تُ]{.ar}
[I]{.trans}
with
[تُمَا]{.ar}
[you~du~]{.trans}.
So we say

(@) [قُلْتُمَا]{.ar}  
    [qultumA]{.trn}  
    [You~du~ said]{.trans}  

Now let's move on to the plurals.
For strong verbs we modify
[ذَهَبَ]{.ar}
[he went]{.trans}
by adding the ;faa3il; pronoun [ـُوا]{.ar} [they~pl.m.~]{.trans}
and we get
[ذَهَبُوا]{.ar}
[they~pl.m.~ went]{.trans}.
We will do the same thing to [قَالَ]{.ar}
[he said]{.trans}
to get:

(@) [قَالُوا]{.ar}  
    [qAlU]{.trn}  
    [They~pl.m.~ said]{.trans}  

For [they~pl.f.~]{.ar},
there is a ;0mark; on the final root letter
(e.g. [ذَهَبْنَ]{.ar} [they~pl.f~ went]{.trans}).
So now we use the pattern
[قُلْتُ]{.ar} I said]{.ar},
and replace the ;faa3il; pronoun [تُ]{.ar} [I]{.trans}
with [نَ]{.ar} [they~pl.f.~]{.trans}.
So we will say:

(@) [قُلْنَ]{.ar}  
    [qulna]{.trn}  
    [They~pl.f.~ said]{.trans}  

Similarly, for [you~pl.m~]{.trans}
we will say:

(@) [قُلْتُمْ]{.ar}  
    [qultum]{.trn}  
    [You~pl.m.~ said]{.trans}  

and
for [you~pl.f~]{.trans}
we will say:

(@) [قُلْتُنَّ]{.ar}  
    [qultunna]{.trn}  
    [You~pl.f.~ said]{.trans}  

Lastly, for [we]{.trans},
we will do the same thing and say:

(@) [قُلْنَا]{.ar}
    [qulnA]{.trn}  
    [We said]{.trans}  

Here is the complete verb conjugation table:

|#;faa3il; pronoun | Conjugation |
|:-----|:---|
|[He]{.trans} | [قَالَ]{.ar} |
|[She]{.trans} | [قَالَتْ]{.ar} |
|[You~sing.m.~]{.trans} | [قُلْتَ]{.ar} |
|[You~sing.f.~]{.trans} | [قُلْتِ]{.ar} |
|[I]{.trans} | [قُلْتُ]{.ar} |
|[They~du.m.~]{.trans} | [قَالَا]{.ar} |
|[They~du.f.~]{.trans} | [قَالَتَا]{.ar} |
|[You~du~]{.trans} | [قُلْتُمَا]{.ar} |
|[They~pl.m.~]{.trans} | [قَالُوا]{.ar} |
|[They~pl.f.~]{.trans} | [قُلْنَ]{.ar} |
|[You~pl.m.~]{.trans} | [قُلْتُمْ]{.ar} |
|[You~pl.f.~]{.trans} | [قُلْتُنَّ]{.ar} |
|[We]{.trans} | [قُلْنَا]{.ar} |
